verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build per batch. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Strixhaven handlers/helpers. Preserve native quirks, repeated queries, context reads and opaque dialogs. Journey boundary is confirmed against the native binary; no gameplay-equivalence claim.
review_notes: Fifty-two alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared local renames. Twenty-three structured definitions use source review and one target build; no new native semantic comparisons.
Keep Expressive selection order/mandatory flags, Alchemist trap queries and mana modes, Golden Ratio power indexing/counts, and Harness hand/grave reverse traversal.
Keep Mastery alternate/full/X charges, fizzle snapshots and marker writes; Restorative validation/return/life order; Deadly Vanities cached availability and current-turn passes.
Keep death-helper eligibility differences, detach flags, source-death early return, per-target index differences, count masks and cleanup; static searches preserve duplicate legacy detection.
Keep Jadzi mana/deck behavior, Onyx dialog/saved-fizzle/discard logic, Nassari and Silencer trigger-context refreshes, Elemental end-trigger/cleanup differences and Rushed Rebirth cleanup kills.

Keep Honor Troll wrapped trigger behavior and separate trigger/static humiliation checks. Opaque dialogs remain out of scope. Journey to the Oracle boundary behavior remains deferred for native inspection.

Final 24 definitions reviewed as one batch; preserve command choice ordering, per-mode target-index advancement and targeting failures, payment/fizzle distinctions, native library array shifts, callback-sensitive mode/target reads, GFP detach differences and cleanup ordering.
Quandrix availability uses independent counters with the same ordered queries and 0/1/99 outcomes; preserve the native shared creature/planeswalker target definition for its cast-time counter mode.

Journey native 0x023d197c branches directly to the indexed read at 0x023d1983 with ebx equal to land_count; decrement follows the read. Zero-count path 0x023d1a83-0x023d1aaa enters the same read. Inclusive/uninitialized-entry behavior retained and documented.
One final target build. Existing reccmp checkpoint inputs remain unchanged. No historical replay or new native gameplay comparison cases.
status: All 99 Strixhaven definitions applied. One final target build follows; reccmp deferred.

native_boundary_review.conclusion: Original binary reads iids[land_count] before decrementing, also when count is zero. Preserved native boundary rather than introducing an initialization or off-by-one repair.
